messages:
olivia: MarinerCapital sent the SIG back with a few "must attach" items: KMS rotation evidence, a one-pager hosted vs reserved pricing, and POC access for compliance. They want a bundle by Friday COB.

sam: I can handle the Q3.x KMS answers and the access review items. Drop their PDF pls.

olivia: PDF uploaded: https://files.redwood.example/mariner/Mariner_SIG_returned_2026-06-10.pdf. They flagged Q3.2, Q3.8, Q4.2.

noah: Security notes: never share key material. Provide rotation policy, key metadata (IDs + last-rotation timestamp), HSM vendor statement, and a signed attestation about control-plane data handling. I can draft attestation tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: uploaded KMS_rotation_policy_2026-06.pdf -> https://files.redwood.example/internal/KMS_rotation_policy_2026-06.pdf

sam: Creating artifact manifest and mapping to SIG questions:

```
artifacts.txt
- SOC2_excerpt.pdf -> Q5.1, Q7.3
- KMS_rotation_policy_2026-06.pdf -> Q3.2
- key_metadata_2026-06.csv -> Q3.2
- access_review_export_2026-05.csv -> Q3.8
- network_seg_diagram_redacted.pdf -> Q4.2
- poc_guide_readonly.md -> POC access
- pricing_onepager_hosted_vs_reserved.pdf -> pricing
```

noah: Pen test note: last vendor pentest 2025-12-02. Executive summary available (redacted). I will remove internal IPs from the network diagram.

olivia: For POC: SE can spin an isolated tenant for 7 days. Cost estimate ~ $1.8k. @finance can you confirm?

finance: Confirmed provisional approval for up to $2k for compliance POC trials if SE owns spend request. Please include cost center and PO after bundle is approved.

sam: Mariner provided sample workload: 200 concurrent users, avg 100 tokens, 15 requests/user/day -> ~300k tokens/day. Ill add 25% buffer and produce hourly QPS.

olivia: Timeline: draft bundle by Thu 18:00 UTC so I can review and send by Fri COB. If we miss, request 48h extension.

noah: Quick security question: do we send full SOC2 or excerpt? I recommend excerpt + cover note calling out redactions.

sam: Agreed. Uploading draft answers now: https://files.redwood.example/drafts/mariner/Mariner_SIG_answers_v1.docx - please review Q3.2 and Q3.8.

security-bot: link preview generated for https://files.redwood.example/drafts/mariner/Mariner_SIG_answers_v1.docx

olivia: Thanks everyone. Tagging this thread as canonical. Ping in-thread for any late edits. :pray:

finance: Once pricing one-pager is ready, cc finance for final numbers.

sam: On it  working on Q3.x now.

noah: Ill prepare the attestation and the pentest cover note tomorrow AM.

olivia: Great. Meeting at 09:30 tomorrow to review bundle.
